about_the_game:
Beyond the Vale is a dark fantasy open-world survival-craft game where players are deposited in a randomly generated map full of mystery and intrigue. Explore the unusual biomes, fight the creatures lurking about, discover the hidden villages with their strange occupants, and build the ultimate base with farming, cooking, animal husbandry, and anything else you might need to survive. With multiple unique playable characters, unlock the secrets of The Vale with friends, or solo, and thrive in this new, strange world we'll all soon come to call home.

Explore The Realm

Start in the familiarity of the Arcadia, but quickly find mystery and intrigue through the six other unique biomes. Explore the light of the bioluminescent Mist, roam the open majesty of the Expanse, climb high into the mountains of the Dread, and find the hidden villages deep in each of the environments.

Meet The Characters

Charles is just some guy. He doesn’t know how he got here, and he’s just trying his best to survive. 

Elm loves plants so much, they learned to talk to them. Convincing them to grow faster and produce more harvestable items, they’ll make sure no one at base goes hungry.

Idris is a tiny tinkerer. He doesn’t say much…or anything. But his enhanced crafting abilities and exclusive items help reinforce bases and ensure your party can stay alive.

Farming and Cooking

Build gardening plots to grow the farm of your dreams, then harvest those crops and turn them into delicious energizing meals to help fuel you for the challenges to come.

Creatures and Combat

Meet creatures great and small and decide whether you’ll tame them or fight them -- either way, you’ll harvest resources that are vital to the survival and expansion of your team. Some may run and hide from you, some may ignore you all together, and the rest will be ready to tear you and your base apart piece by piece.

Building and Crafting

Build the ultimate base block-by-block to protect yourself and your items from the monsters that lurk in the world. Craft decorations to make the space feel more like home, and traps to protect your walls from destruction. The sky’s the limit for creation, so long as you’re brave enough to harvest the necessary resources.
